description: This PHP source file defines the SageMakerClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the Amazon SageMaker Service. It includes method annotations for various SageMaker API operations, indicating the capabilities provided by this client class.

classes.name: SageMakerClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS SageMaker Service, extending the generic AWS client class. It provides methods corresponding to SageMaker API actions, annotated for IDE auto-completion and static analysis.

methods.name: addAssociation
methods.description: Adds an association between SageMaker trial components or experiments.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Adds tags to a SageMaker resource.

methods.name: associateTrialComponent
methods.description: Associates a trial component with a trial.

methods.name: batchDeleteClusterNodes
methods.description: Deletes multiple cluster nodes in an SageMaker domain.
